notes.title: v1.2.5 "Richard's Roundup" Update
notes.content:
[h2]A Fun Bonus Update![/h2]

This update is a little bigger than a hotfix but mainly serves to fix up a number of parts of the game as we head out of Early Access

[h3]Changes and Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Game now has an intro credits sequence on boot
[*] New songs have been added for Lester's Test Arcade and Memory Zoo!
[*] Stamper's "Thank You" animation has been drastically improved
[*] Gems and pickups now have a bigger hitbox
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed various tile errors
[*] Fixed occasional crash when using PlayStation controllers in the item bonus screen
[*] Spray n' Pray now unlocks and shows up correctly in Lester's Test Arcade
[/list]

notes.title: v1.1.1 Hotfix
notes.content:
Hey guys! Just a quick update to fix and polish up some of the new additions from the last one! Here's the changes:

[list]
[*] Lester now has a few more lines of dialogue
[*] Items placed in the testing room now snap to the grid
[*] Fixed graphical issues in Richard's shop
[*] Arcade cursor can no longer be moved while the game is paused
[/list]

Thanks so much for playing the game, please look forward to more major content soon!

notes.title: v1.1 "The Unlikely Lester" Update
notes.content:
This is it, the first big update and milestone on the way to releasing out of Early Access! "The Unlikely Lester" update adds several pretty huge features, including:
[h2]Major Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] "Dream Boy" item and enemy database
[*] "Lester's Test Arcade" building added in hub
[*] Two new achievements!
[/list]
[h2]Fixes and improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] All in game text is now outlined for better readability
[*] Improved difficulty selection with descriptions
[*] Item bonus screen now includes item descriptions
[*] Softlock fixed in Watch Your Step
[*] Lightning in a Bottle and Speed Citrus no longer cancel each other out
[*] Pipes can no longer be entered while the game is paused
[/list]

Thanks so much for all your support on the game since launch, especially in your wonderful reviews that currently have us listed as 100% positive!! I read each and every one and they've been making my day every time a new one shows up, so please keep them coming if you can! I hope this update stands as a representation of our commitment to making this game better and better, expect more very soon!

notes.title: v1.01 Hotfix
notes.content:
Hi everyone, thanks for an amazing launch week! I wanted to push a few easy changes that address some of the most common feedback for the game, which mainly serve to improve the UI.

[list]
[*] Armor now collapses into stacks of 5, preventing it from bloating the HUD and stretching across the whole screen. Well, unless you get an insane amount of armor.
[*] Passive items now wrap after hitting the edge of the screen, so you can see all of them at once! I'm going to be adding a menu soon where you can view all of your current items but this should be a nice QOL improvement to tide you guys over until then.
[*] Fixed the bug where your damage number resets to 0 when you go to the next level on the results screen.
[/list]

Thanks so much for playing the game, more updates to come very soon!
